meta.name: ask-matt
meta.description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据你的需求推荐合适的技能或流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你不确定该用哪个技能来完成当前任务。
copy.tagline_en: Recommend the right skill or flow for your situation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are unsure which skill to use for your current task.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成一个技能导航员。当你不知道用哪个技能或流程时，它会根据你的描述推荐最合适的技能或路径，并解释如何衔接。
howto.when: 当你对当前任务不确定该用哪个技能，或者想了解整个技能体系的流程时，可以主动询问。

say.text: 我想开发一个新功能，但不确定从哪开始。
我有一堆 bug 报告，该怎么处理？
这个设计问题很难在纸上决定，怎么办？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a skill navigator. When you don't know which skill or flow to use, it recommends the most suitable one based on your description and explains how to proceed.
howto.when_en: When you are unsure which skill to use for a task or want to understand the overall skill workflow, you can ask Matt for guidance.

say_en.text: I want to build a new feature but don't know where to start.
say_en.note: Matt will guide you into the main flow, starting with /grill-with-docs.

say_en.text: I have a pile of bug reports, how should I handle them?
say_en.note: Matt will recommend /triage for handling externally submitted bugs.

say_en.text: This design question is hard to settle on paper, what should I do?
say_en.note: Matt will suggest using /prototype to build a quick throwaway prototype.
